obligations.text: Profile revision 28 replaces revision 22 while the exact spec-spine pin stays =0.32.0, the ordinary Rust code gate, corpus attestation and spec DAG remain required, and the derived directory stays at .statecraft/derived/.

record.summary: Authorizes the migration from Statecraft github-actions-rust revision 22 to revision 28 in one pull request. Revision 28's producer still links spec-spine-core 0.32.0, so the exact engine pin does not move and the policy-isolation guard sees no policy path beside the re-render. The revisions between add the reviewer contract, post-merge pushes under a required merge queue, an optional free-disk step, review severities and notes, and a policy guard that ignores a self-pin and the owning spec. Aicortex keeps its ordinary Rust code gate, corpus attestation and spec DAG jobs, and declares no merge queue or free-disk parameter.
record.title: Adopt Statecraft profile revision 28 with spec-spine staying at 0.32.0
